findings.suggested_fix: Give one matching patient two Completed appointments and require each matching patient to appear in exactly one row.
findings.text: S-3 AC2 (search) never gives a matching patient several appointments. A join that repeats rows inside search results could still return 'the same patients as before'. S-3 AC1 covers this only for the unfiltered list.

rubric_items.reason: All twelve known REQs (REQ-1 to REQ-12) are traced by S-1 to S-5. The intent has no assumed or unknown REQs.
Each story has one clear outcome. S-1 still groups the column, the time-zone rule and the format, but all three describe the same displayed value.

All ACs use Given/When/Then. AC2 crosses midnight between Asia/Kolkata and UTC. Each exclusion partition is covered. S-3 AC1 now catches duplicate rows from a join, and S-5 AC1 covers all five medical-history fields.
Every value comes from the intent or is derived inline: 21 patients from 20 per page, and the UTC+05:30 conversions are shown next to the times.
Terms are clear and match the glossary (Completed, Scheduled, No-show, Cancelled), and Last visit and Next appointment are used the same way throughout.
